weight_note: vote_choice_24 is a political item and the query is broken down or filtered by state, so the rule picks weight_vote_state (demographics plus vote and turnout, calibrated within each state).
suppression_note: Cells with n<10 suppressed for privacy
note: All rates/means/pct are WEIGHTED (population-representative). unweighted_n is raw headcount for reliability checks only — never use it to compute percentages.
interpretation_note: Each row is one demographic_value × response_value combination. pct_within_demo = WEIGHTED % of that demographic group giving this response — rows sum to ~100% within each demographic_value. unweighted_n = raw respondent headcount (reliability check only). Always label pct_within_demo as 'weighted %' when presenting to users.
